name: Country-Aware Address Block (server-composed)
description: The standard address entry block. Its fields, labels and cascading lookups are NOT authored in the page — the whole sub-layout is fetched from the server as JSON and rendered by the `view` atom. This is how country-specific address shapes (emirate vs state vs province, postcode formats) stay centralised. Never hand-build an address form; wire this instead.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md 7 (_fapi-whenload-events: the two filldataset calls and the dsAddress seed)

viewDataset.description: Holds the fetched layout, e.g. "dsCountryMasterDeliverTo". Name it per address role (DeliverTo / BillTo) if a page has more than one.

dataDataset.description: Holds the address VALUES the sub-layout binds to, e.g. "dsAddress".

fieldMap.description: Translation from this page's field names to the address component's generic names.

rules: All three whenload actions are required and ordered: fetch the view layout, fetch the sub-view layout, then seed the data dataset.
The layout arrives in the `settingsView` FIELD of the fetched dataset — the view atom binds [<viewDataset>.settingsView], not the dataset itself.
The page's own field names never reach the component; the mergedataset step translates them to the generic names above. Keep that mapping in one place.
layout_docno values observed: "country-master-view-new" and "country-subview-default-new". Treat them as the current defaults rather than hard requirements.
